name: letsencrypt
description: Let's Encrypt/Certbot operational guidance for public HTTPS endpoints.
guidelines: Validate the public hostname and working HTTP route before live certificate issuance.
Use Certbot non-interactively with an explicit contact email and Nginx integration.
Use staging for rehearsal when requested and do not treat a staging certificate as production-ready.
Verify HTTPS externally after issuance and perform renewal dry-run checks.
